reasons.priceHigherThanMax: The claimed "original" price ({originalPrice}) is {percentage}% higher than the highest price we've observed ({maxPrice}) across {observations} observations ({days} days of tracking) — the discount may be misleading.
reasons.priceHigherThan30DayLow: Current price ({currentPrice}) is {percentage}% above the lowest price in the last 30 days ({minPrice}) based on {observations} observations ({days} days of tracking).
reasons.belowAverage: Current price ({currentPrice}) is {percentage}% below the average ({avgPrice}) across {observations} observations ({days} days of tracking).
reasons.atAllTimeLow: The current price {currentPrice} is near the observed low of {minPrice} ({observations} observations over {days} days). This is a pricing signal, not a guarantee of the best offer.
reasons.stablePrice: Price has remained stable through the last 30 days based on {observations} observations ({days} days of tracking).
reasons.volatilePrice: Price has varied by {percentage}% across {observations} observations ({days} days of tracking) — it may be worth waiting for a better offer.
reasons.insufficientData: At least {needed} price observations needed for a reliable verdict ({current}/{needed} so far).
reasons.noPatternMatch: Price is being tracked ({observations} observations over {days} days) but no discount pattern matched yet.
reasons.extractionFailed: The price could not be read. Refresh the page.
reasons.trackingFailed: The price was not saved. Check extension storage usage and try again.

widget.unavailableReason: The page offers no price you can buy at right now (for example, the product is out of stock), so nothing is recorded today. Any history already collected is kept.
widget.claimedHint: The "was" price the store shows next to today's price
widget.disclaimer: Based only on prices recorded in this browser. A signal, not proof.
widget.chartLabel: Price history: {count} observations from {from} to {to}. Lowest {low}, highest {high}.

products.emptyBody: Open a product on any supported store and its price is recorded automatically, once a day.
products.noResultsBody: Try a different search or store.

settings.showWidgetDesc: When off, prices are still recorded in this browser — the panel just isn't shown.
settings.storesDesc: A store that's off is not tracked and shows no panel.

data.backupDesc: Export your price history as JSON or restore it from a backup. Settings and price targets aren't included.
data.importInTab: Import opens in a tab so the file picker works reliably.
data.clearAllDesc: Permanently deletes every tracked product and its recorded prices.
data.clearConfirmBody: Every tracked product and every recorded price will be removed. This can't be undone — export a backup first if you might need it.
data.importSummary: {imported} imported, {skipped} skipped as invalid. Images refresh on the next retailer visit.

errors.invalidFile: That file isn't a Fake Discount backup
